items.title: Booking Holdings (BKNG) Backs New York Launch With Lola VIP Drops And Broader Travel Services
items.summary: Booking Holdings (NasdaqGS:BKNG) backed Lola launched its Lola VIP Drops service in New York, offering exclusive last minute reservations and event access. The rollout is supported by a significant new funding injection from Booking Holdings that expands Lola's travel services footprint. Lola is adding partnerships that cover flights, car rentals, tours and airport services, broadening its offering beyond restaurant access.
